link.title: 4. ANOVA (Analysis of Variance)
link.description: The test for comparing the means of three or more groups at once, without inflating the error rate of many pairwise t-tests. This sub-module works up from the definition and vocabulary (factors and levels) through the assumptions, the types of ANOVA, and how the total variance is partitioned into between-group and within-group pieces to form the F-statistic.
